summary: Iteration 23 — Verified the TUS-proxy chunked-upload fix for the RLS-403 bug. Backend endpoints POST /api/admin/sessions/{id}/tus-create-upload and POST /api/admin/tus-patch-chunk both work end-to-end: 5 MB single-chunk and 12 MB two-chunk uploads succeed, HEAD on the resulting Supabase public URL returns 200 with the correct content-length. Frontend VideoEditor and AdminPanel SessionVideosTab both use the new chunk-proxy flow (tus-js-client has been removed from imports). All testids present and enabled, footer text mentions both '8 MB' chunk size and '50 GB Pro ceiling'. No 'tus is not defined' or any tus-related errors in the console. Dev-sim spreadsheet renders correctly.

issues: One React hydration warning in the console: '<span> option cannot be a child of ...'. This is emitted somewhere in the sidebar/nav tree — unrelated to video-upload but visible in dev builds. Consider tracking down and fixing separately.

critical_code_review_comments: VideoEditor.jsx (uploadWithChunkProxy) and AdminPanel.jsx > SessionVideosTab.uploadFor still duplicate the chunk-proxy loop (same CHUNK_SIZE constant, same offset accumulation, same 3-attempt retry). Extract into a shared helper (e.g. /lib/tusChunkUpload.js) — this is the third iteration where the same block has been copy-pasted between the two files.
Bucket name 'session-videos' is still hard-coded in both files; move to a shared constants module.
wave_endpoints.py is now 2069 lines — well over the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting admin endpoints into per-domain modules (admin_video.py, admin_curriculum.py, admin_users.py, etc.).

admin_tus_create_upload validates upload_length with Field(ge=1, le=53_687_091_200) via _AdminTusCreateBody but the class is redefined a second time INSIDE the router function (line 1112). The duplicate class shadows the module-level one — harmless but confusing. Remove one of the two definitions.

admin_tus_patch_chunk currently uses synchronous urllib.request inside an async endpoint (line 1144–1160). For large chunks, this blocks the event loop. Consider using httpx.AsyncClient or running via run_in_executor.
